running-o2-cost.label: Oxygen cost of running
running-o2-cost.value: about 200 mL·kg⁻¹·km⁻¹ (about 220 in trained men; about the same at all steady speeds below threshold), about 4.1 kJ·kg⁻¹·km⁻¹

gross-efficiency-cycling.label: Gross efficiency in cycling
gross-efficiency-cycling.value: about 20% (20.2% and 20.5% in two lab studies of men)

adipose-energy.label: Energy stored in adipose tissue, lean athlete (7–14% body fat)

glycogen-muscle-total.label: Glycogen stored in all skeletal muscle (adult)

glycogen-liver.label: Glycogen stored in the liver
glycogen-liver.value: about 80–100 g (lower after an overnight fast)

ultra-intake-share.label: Energy eaten during ultra-endurance races as a share of energy used
